summary: PROG Holdings filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) disclosing a board-declared quarterly cash dividend of $0.14 per share, payable December 1, 2026 to holders of record November 17, 2026, with a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. No advisor or board recommendation language beyond the declaration; no buyback authorization, special dividend, or structural terms were disclosed. This is a routine recurring quarterly capital return, not a tender or special distribution. What to watch: any future increase, special dividend, or repurchase authorization signaling a shift in capital allocation.
